family: The single total fixed-strength certificate-prefix language defined in proof.md and family.py, with STRENGTH=1024 and delta=1/1024 fixed independently of input length. At actual length N its guarded uniform algorithm reads a validated list of odd-degree field polynomials from an input prefix, charges all prefix bits to N, zero-pads the payload to N coordinates, and runs the balanced-tree challenge-response construction with the explicit strength-scaled fixed integer parameters. Every failed shape or prefix test returns zero. All remaining choices are deterministic. The polynomial runtime has an enormous fixed exponent; practical input lengths take the documented constant-zero guard.
theorem: For this one fixed total language in P, hence NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-9N^(1/1024) for every sufficiently large integer actual length N in the full pinned B2 model. Its complete guarantee implies liminf C_B2(F_N)/N>=4. Every extractor, field, gate and parameter argument is supplied; STRENGTH is fixed and does not grow with N, and no subpolynomial-remainder endpoint is asserted.
